lines: It has 391,305 GitHub stars for an AI that runs on your devices.
The pain hits when you want an AI assistant but it lives in a cloud account and ignores your local files.
OpenClaw meets you in channels like Discord, Slack, Telegram or iMessage.
The gateway handles local sessions directly on your computer.
Use slash commands to add tools and skills directly from ClawHub.
Governance is managed by the OpenClaw Foundation, which operates as an independent 501(c)(3).
You configure your AI model settings here. Then you add new tools directly from ClawHub.
The installer works on macOS, Linux, Windows and WSL2.
It runs on MIT license, built by OpenClaw Foundation and tested at Lobster Computer Company.
Run openclaw onboard with flag --install-daemon to start.
Send this to someone who wants an AI on their own computer.
This is OpenClaw, an open-source AI that really does things.
